title: A hand-edited opt-in that does not meet the schema is read in canonical form before the post-write check
evidence: Filed 2026-11-27 from the R9 review. A record whose reminderOptIn object does not meet the schema (edited by hand) can make the post-write check (optInBehind, packages/health-core/src/reminder-rows.ts:60, called from roadmap-doc.ts:76) see a difference that is only form, so a save that landed is reported as failed. Fix in rowsOf (reminder-rows.ts:33): read every row in canonical form before the comparison. US-17 AC19.
